Why not Woodland?

If he drives it like that at Augusta he will reach all the par 5s in two, he’ll drive the green on #3, fly the bunker on #5, and have short iron/wedge into most of the other par 4s.

Would be an amazing story.


WildBillNC (@WildBillNC1978)

Governor, list your Top 5 Masters picks. I'll go first.

Bryson DeChambeau
Patrick Reed
Cam Young
Justin Rose
Scottie Scheffler



— https://nitter.net/WildBillNC1978/status/2038388109935591641#m

True but you can throw a dart at a map of FL and find people from Ohio.  They are not concentrated in SWFL.


LC (@aspire_LC)

Ohio too! There’s streets named after Ohio and winter parties specifically for Ohioans too!



— https://nitter.net/aspire_LC/status/2038425193874337907#m

You won’t get very far in SWFL without running into someone from Wisconsin in the Winter/Spring.  I could say the same for Indiana, Illinois, Minnesota, and Michigan.


Nick MacCudden (@nickmaccud)

We Wisconsinites love Florida in the winter (and spring break, we're here now)!



— https://nitter.net/nickmaccud/status/2038360905621053446#m

I like KC but have never been to St. Louis, which I need to do as it’s a great baseball city.

I’m a big fan of KC BBQ and I like how Arrowhead is right there too.


Mitchell (@ScottsOriole)

Any thoughts on the two Missouri Parks? 

Kauffman and Busch both fly under the radar imo .. with Kauffman having modern aesthetics that actually work and Busch with a great downtown location and fans that love baseball more (arguably) than any other market?



— https://nitter.net/ScottsOriole/status/20380

The men who drafted the Fourteenth Amendment (as well as members of the society who ratified it) would be shocked that their handiwork was being used as justification for this absurdity.


Geiger Capital (@Geiger_Capital)

Chinese men are paying to have surrogate children on US territorial islands in the Pacific…

They pay to have babies born "in the US" and then immediately ship them to China to be raised under the CCP. They then get American benefits and in a few years can vote in our election

Absolutely mashing those drives!

Will be exciting to see at the Masters.


PGA TOUR (@PGATOUR)

A dominant return to the winner's circle 🏆

Gary Woodland captures his first title in 6 years, 9 months and 13 days @TCHouOpen.





— https://nitter.net/PGATOUR/status/2038375257984094393#m

There are a lot of people who live in SWFL who spend the summer up in Lake Geneva.  I’ve been there and it’s pretty.


Scott Stephan (@ScottStephan)

Check out Lake Geneva in August. Sweetcorn 🤤



— https://nitter.net/ScottStephan/status/2038326545500995654#m

My wife and I did it about 15-20 years ago.  I’m a fan of the brats and the cheese curds.  They had good music too.


CTaylorEsq.🇺🇸🐘⚖️ (@NonSequitur96)

Awesome, Governor. Have you experienced Summerfest? If not, you should definitely put on your bucket list.



— https://nitter.net/NonSequitur96/status/2038344833341776118#m

That bill is not tied to the November ballot; it’s the first I’ve heard of it but it seems to have died in committee and never even received a floor vote.  

There is no proposal for any new tax or any increase of an existing tax.  The state has a full rainy day fund and a large amount of budget reserves.


JC (@jde140)

Appreciate that. Off topic. What are your thoughts of this being hidden in Property Tax Relief Bill?





— https://nitter.net/jde140/status/2038315469912838470#m

One of the things I’m happy we did was send rebates to Prepaid families in recent years.

Since we’ve frozen tuition the expected cost of tuition was less and so more than $1 billion has been refunded.

Most other states would have spent that money instead of rebating it to the families.

You’ll be impressed with the beaches in NW FL.


Laurie 🇺🇸🐾🎣☀️🌸 (@LaurieFLPatriot)

We are hitting this area this summer for a staycation.  Only part of Florida I haven’t been to yet.  Can’t wait to see the beaches.



— https://nitter.net/LaurieFLPatriot/status/2038294480843841894#m

What a ridiculous map!  

It’s an example of complete ignorance of Florida history and culture.


All Things Emerald Coast (@AllEmeraldCoast)

LOL imagine saying this from Jacksonville though… the audacity is high 😂





— https://nitter.net/AllEmeraldCoast/status/2038271493075787874#m
Market seems to be pricing in further inflation.  Mortgage rates are also up in recent weeks.

Swing is looking good!


Oklahoma City Comets (@OKC_comets)

His name is James Tibbs III.

He wears #3.

Of course he hit a triple. What else did you expect?

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/OKC_comets/status/2038046572248728028#m

I don’t think the Trop is “so bad.”

But it is not in the same class as Fenway, PNC, Wrigley, SanFran or Camden Yards, as well as others like Petco, old Yankee Stadium, etc.


Brandon Johnson (@brxAgain)

Why do you think the Trop is so bad? It's what Florida needs - nice and cool, protected from Thunderstorms, and seats plenty while the population keeps growing..



— https://nitter.net/brxAgain/status/2038088957850730958#m

No way.  When you walk up and see the Green Monster it is a unique experience.  

Not everything needs to be a modern luxury.  There is a charm to the place especially given all the history there.


SealedGain (@SealedGain)

Fenway looks nice on TV, but actually sucks to attend



— https://nitter.net/SealedGain/status/2038018134762811577#m

It’d be hard to beat having the Polo Grounds, Yankee Stadium and Ebbets Field all in the same city.


AlbatrossHunter (@ZebbaWax)

Agreed, Ron. The old one was a dangerous environment for the road team. Especially near the bleachers in a close game. On a side note it would be cool to travel back in time and see a game at the Polo Grounds.



— https://nitter.net/ZebbaWax/status/2038066400019743196#m

I haven’t been since my Navy days but it is definitely a great park.


Tim K 🇺🇸 (@Tim_Koerner)

Petco in San Diego is awesome as well.



— https://nitter.net/Tim_Koerner/status/2038063301825876234#m

Yes I like it.  I also like Milwaukee in the summer.


Illinois Conservative🇺🇸🇻🇦 (@IL4Liberty)

Ever been to American Family field (aka Miller Park & County Stadium)? 

I’ll be there tomorrow. Awesome place.



— https://nitter.net/IL4Liberty/status/2038057584167473335#m

Uh, I don’t think anyone is claiming the Trop is a great ballpark…


Joey (@JosephH11112238)

If you don’t like the new Yankee stadium I’d love your thoughts on the trop which looks like the most depressing place ever to watch a game



— https://nitter.net/JosephH11112238/status/2038068501890355663#m
